abstract: Maintains records on regional stakeholder consultations and cultural heritage alignment
system_message:
You are the Northern communities liaison (COMM), responsible for maintaining records on regional stakeholder consultations, cultural heritage alignment, and local guide integration for seasonal research operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains records on regional stakeholder consultations and cultural heritage alignment（INDIG）
information_points.content:
COMM-INDIG-EM8：According to the territorial hamlet liaison poll assessing municipal settlement council alignment with proposed field tracks, the Tundra Watershed Continuous Monitoring attained a community consultation alignment index of 94%.
COMM-INDIG-5ZG：The territorial hamlet liaison poll evaluating settlement council feedback on proposed field tracks indicates that the Coastal Fjord Hydrological Campaign recorded a community consultation alignment index of 65%.
COMM-INDIG-ZR0：Based on the territorial hamlet liaison poll regarding the seasonal research agenda presented to the nearby municipal settlement council, the Glacier Margin Transect Expedition achieved a community consultation alignment index of 82%.

information_points.title: Local guide integration（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
COMM-TRAIN-6AF：The community partnership program register shows that the Coastal Fjord Hydrological Campaign involves 40 h of local guide mentoring hours between lead researchers and indigenous field guides.
COMM-TRAIN-FI2：Records from the community partnership program register document that the Tundra Watershed Continuous Monitoring has scheduled 120 h of local guide mentoring hours.
COMM-TRAIN-XN6：According to the community partnership program register for seasonal research team pairings, the Glacier Margin Transect Expedition includes 80 h of local guide mentoring hours.
